note: Stanbic IBTC Bank: its Visa Platinum Naira credit card charges 3% a month in interest; its management fee, 1% of the card's limit at issue, renewal and each limit increase, depends on a limit the game's cards don't keep and isn't written, nor is its N1,075 new card fee. Access Bank's rates guide gives its cards 2.5% on the outstanding balance with no period, and wasn't taken.
